shots.action: The sun cracks over a jagged Andean peak; a stone sun-god altar ignites with golden light.
Aerial sweep over terraced Inca mountains above the clouds at golden hour, a condor's shadow passing.
Macro: molten gold-red sauce poured over a rustic Andean dish on a sunlit stone slab, glistening.
The Sauce Empire bottle silhouetted against the rising sun on a mountain altar, golden rim light.
